entry_item.definition: T. phung po; S. skandha. Mass, constitutive aggregate. There are five : The form or visible or corporeal aggregate (dyrsyn, T. gzugs, S. rūpa) the sensation aggr.; (serekyi, T. tshor ba,S. vedanā) the ideation aggr.; (sedkikyl, T. hdu çes, S. samjnā) the formative or constructive aggr; (xuran yiledkyi, T. hdu byed, S. samskāra) and the consciousness-building aggr (tein medekyi T. mam par çes S. vijnāna).

example.definition: T. mehi phung po; S agni-skandha. Bonfire,' mass of fire to which is compared the appearance of light in meditation.
T. phung po gsum; S. tri-skandha. The three aggregates: morality, concentration (meditation), and gnosis. ED 607 B, under skandha.
